tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects visible to the signed-in user (RLS applied), with type, dates, budget, hours, progress, client, leader and billing metadata. Supports filtering by status, area, project type, client, name search and an activity date window.

status.description: Filter by project_status (aperto, in_partenza, da_fatturare, completato).

area.description: Filter by area (marketing, tech, branding, sales, ai, struttura, interno).

project_type.description: Filter by project_type (e.g. pack, recurring, one_shot).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on project name.

active_from.description: Only projects whose end_date is on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

active_to.description: Only projects whose start_date is on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Fetch a full project card by id (RLS applied): type, area, discipline, status, progress, dates, economics (budget, hours, discount, margin, additional costs), client and contact, leader/account, team members, planned activities, external links (Drive, Slack, quote number) and the latest progress updates.

tools.name: get_project_summary
tools.title: Get project summary
tools.description: Return a summary of a project (visible to the signed-in user via RLS): planned budget and hours, confirmed hours and cost from time tracking, plus additional costs. Numbers reflect only rows the caller is allowed to see.

tools.name: list_project_time_entries
tools.title: List project time entries
tools.description: List confirmed time-tracking entries for a project, with person, planned activity, linked client (internal projects), hours and notes, plus aggregated summaries (total hours, per person, per activity, per week). Visibility: admins see everyone, team leaders only users in their areas, other roles only their own entries.

user_id.description: Restrict to a single user UUID.

tools.name: list_project_tasks
tools.title: List project tasks
tools.description: List operational tasks of a project (RLS applied): title, status, priority, start/due dates, estimated hours, assignees and the linked planned activity. Filter by status, priority or due date window.

status.description: Filter by status (backlog, todo, in_progress, done, blocked — as stored).

priority.description: Filter by priority (high, normal, low — as stored).

due_before.description: Only tasks with due_date on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

due_after.description: Only tasks with due_date on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: list_my_time_entries
tools.title: List my time entries
tools.description: List time-tracking entries recorded by the signed-in user, optionally within a date range. Uses RLS so only the caller's data is returned.

tools.name: list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List confirmed time-tracking entries. Pass user_id (UUID) or user_search (a person's name/email). Admins can query any user; team leaders are limited to users in their assigned areas; other roles are limited to their own entries. Only entries with actual_start_time and actual_end_time set are returned. Returns the entries plus an aggregated summary (total hours, hours per project).

user_id.description: Filter by user UUID. Requires admin, or team_leader access to that user's area.

user_search.description: Alternative to user_id: a name or email fragment. If several users match, the tool returns the candidates instead of entries.

tools.name: find_users
tools.title: Find users
tools.description: Search approved TimeTrap users by name or email and return their UUIDs. Use this first to resolve a person's name into a user_id before calling list_time_entries. Admins can search everyone; team leaders only users in their areas; other roles only themselves.

query.description: Name, surname, full name or email fragment (case-insensitive).
